name: wf-postmortem
description: wf postmortem pack: the postmortem capability, a presence-only feature that ships a guided skill hunting a described failure through prior agent sessions the maintainer names explicitly. Each named session is read by its own isolated reader agent on a cheaper model tier — in ordered windows when a record is too large for one reader — so raw session content never enters the host context. Every reader-suggested mechanism with a locator is then checked two-sided, against the audited pack's own text at its resolved executed version and against a bounded, redacted excerpt fetched fresh at the locator, and promoted to a confirmed contributing factor only when both sides verify. Owns no provider surface and attaches no phase fragment — it ships inert until registered and behaves identically whether or not it is. Locating sessions, fix direction, and cap enforcement arrive with later charter sub-tasks. Ships /wf-postmortem:postmortem, the guided skill, plus /wf-postmortem:init for one-command self-registration.
